Backed by diversified product portfolio and mature business system, Saga Telecom gains good feedback overseas especially in USA, Turkey, Italy, Russia and India.

Production Equipment

The standard production mainly consists of 8 steps
Processing>Cleaning>Assembling>Testing>Aging>Performance Testing>QC Testing>Packing
PCBA Processing: SMT welding and DIP insertion.
With professional equipment, this increase accuracy and efficiency.
Cleaning: To avoid any possible dysfunction due to dust or scraps on the PCB boards.
Conformal coatings will sometimes be used to protected the PCB boards.
Assembling: Build up components of a product, like panels, screws, PCB boards.
Basic Testing: To make sure the product, after assembling, is basically working fine such as LED indicator, voltage range...
Aging: This is a preparation step for comprehensive performance test.
Devices will be put in the ageing chamber for 24 to 48 hours.
Performance Testing: This requires professional equipment to check if the device meets the standard such as lighting surge, data loss or working temperature range...
THIS IS THE MOST IMPORTANT STEP TO SECURE GOOD QUALITY.
QC Testing: This is the third and also last check covering product appearance and ping testing.
Device outlook will be inspected to avoid improperly placed PVC mask or scratches on the casing.
Ping testing will be done to all the devices and then there will be another random testing.
Packing: Labels will be attached on the device, accessories(user manual, mounting kit, power supply ...)will be placed in the box for sealing.
When all above is done, the product will go to market.
Remark
Ageing Time: 8 to 24 hours(at least 8 hours)
8 hours for frequently ordered models
24 hours for customized models to ensure stable operation.
The actual ageing time depends on complaint rate and order urgency.
If we have not received negative feedback for a long time(like popular models STI-244GP and STI-050GE), we simply do the ageing time 8 hours for fast delivery.
STAFF IS THE BEST ASSET OF A COMPANY.
Training is vital to sales professionalism and work ability. Saga Telecom conducts 1 to 2 hours of training every 2 weeks including
Product features, industry knowledge, changes in competitors, etc.

Packing: Labels will be attached on the device, accessories(user manual, mounting kit, power supply ...)will be placed in the box for sealing.

If early tests and communication failed to identify the problem, an online meeting will be held to better discuss the after-sales issues(usually on Zoom or Microsoft Teams)
